title: More Accessible Andesite
description: Adds 5 Recipes for Andesite in order to make it easier to access.
body:
Adds 5 Recipes for Andesite:

**1) Gravel -> Andesite (Smelting)**

**2) 2 Gravel + 2 Cobblestone (2x2)**

**3) 8 Cobblestone + Iron Nugget (3x3)**

**4) 2 Granite + 2 Quartz (2x2)**

**5) Stone -> Andesite (Stonecutting)**

The mod is intended to be played with Create Mod.
